title: DBX-DEP: the narrowest recovery when something fails

questions.ask: Did two tasks of a job fail?
questions.yes: Repair run: only failed tasks and their dependants

questions.ask: Did one or two pipeline tables fail after a transient error?
Must a new source feed an existing streaming table?
questions.yes: An append flow, with a one-time ONCE flow for the backfill

questions.ask: Must one setting of a job change via the CLI?
questions.yes: jobs update with the changed fields, not jobs reset

otherwise: Pick the lowest rung that restores a correct state; a full refresh can lose history
caption: Read from the top: the first situation that matches gives the narrow fix; the wide option is the trap.
alt: Decision ladder: failed job tasks point to a repair run; failed pipeline tables to refreshing them; a new source to an append flow; one job setting to jobs update.
